items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: we used to go up there and rehearse all the time

ctx.x: We made that record in the studio, in the radio station.

W.R. Wilde on Josephine Drys. Josephine. Oh, you mean M-O-Y. Oh, W-M-O-Y. Yeah. And, uh, well I was just sitting and, uh, we used to go up there and rehearse all the time. And, uh, we was in there and, uh, the guy said he wanted to see how we sound playing something that, uh, we made up. So, we played that.
